roruva.p: [Ru+a] (pu,na) CL=7 [Moga,5.7va nirutti.597. Ruru+aṇa. Amara,ṭī. It finishes form as Lolupa, momūha words. Bhusaṃ, punappunaṃ vā dukkhitasaddena ravanti asmiṃ roruvo. Dhāna,ṭī,657.(saṃ,ṭṭha,1.77. Jā,ṭṭha,5,288). Rorava-saṃ. Rorua-prā, addhamāgadhī.] (1) Roruva hell. (2) Roruva King. (3) Roruva City. See original.
pn:
Roruva 02. A Niraya. Beings were presumably born there as a result of casting aspersions on the Dhamma (SN.i.30), miserliness (e.g., Ja.iii.299) and adultery (Ja.vi.237). Sometimes (Ja.v.266) two Roruvas are mentioned which the scholiast (Ja.v.271) explains as being Jālaroruva and Dhūmaroruva; in the first beings have red hot flames blown into their bodies, and in the second, noxious gases (khāradhūma).

Buddhaghosa says (SN-a.i.64) that Jālaroruva is another name for Avīci, and that the Niraya is so-called because beings shout while being burnt there (aggimhi jalante punappunaṁ ravanti).
a: ရောရုဝ(ပု၊န)

B:
roruva： roruva（pu，na）
ရောရုဝ（ပု၊န）
«ru+a．，5．7va nirutti．597．ruru+．amara，ṭī．lolupaç momūha- eiea．bhusaṃç punappunaṃ vā dukkhitasaddena ravanti asmiṃ roruvo．，ṭī，657．（saṃ，ṭṭha，1．77．jā，ṭṭha，5，288）．rorava-saṃ．rorua-prā，addhamāgadhī．]
[ရု+အ။ မောဂ်၊၅။၇ဝ နိရုတ္တိ။၅၉၇။ ရုရု+အဏ်။ အမရ၊ဋီ။ လောလုပ，မောမူဟ-ပုဒ်တို့ကဲ့သို့ ရုပ်ပြီး၏။ ဘုသံ，ပုနပ္ပုနံ ဝါ ဒုက္ခိတသဒေ္ဒန ရဝန္တိ အသ္မိံ ရောရုဝေါ။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ၊၆၅၇။ （သံ၊ဋ္ဌ၊၁။၇၇။ ဇာ၊ဋ္ဌ၊၅၊၂၈၈）။ ရောရဝ-သံ။ ရောရုအ-ပြာ၊ အဒ္ဓမာဂဓီ။]

roruka.p: [Ani] (na) CL=7 [Pāṭi. Rorukasakkatapiṭaka. Purāṇamrepuṃ-176. It is bank of Indu river in Parkistan Country]. Roruka City.
pn: Roruka 01. A city, capital of the Sovīras, established by Jotipāla, chaplain of Reṇu. Its king was Bharata. (DN.ii.235; cp. Mvu.iii.208; see also Divy.544ff). In the Ādittajātaka (Ja 424, Ja.iii.470) it is called Roruva.

B:
roruka： roruka（na）
ရောရုက（န）
«ani，pāṭi．rorukasakkatapiṭaka．pumrepuṃ-176．pākacca-indunitea rhi．]
[အနိ၊ ပါဋိ။ ရောရုကသက္ကတပိဋက။ ပုရာဏ်မြေပုံ-၁၇၆။ ပါကစ္စတန်-ဣန္ဒုမြစ်ကမ်း၌ ရှိသည်။]
